answer: A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, because the sample is drawn from the ledge beacon after the epoch ends and the harbor nonce differs from the first. Each close, 25% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. Since the crystal audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. That is 39 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
